content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect handling of metadata on the E-switch manager vport (0xfffe) instead of the own vport. This led to traffic tagged by ingress ACL not being processed correctly at the NIC RX flow table level, as the metadata tag was not being utilized properly. The patch corrects this by ensuring that metadata is enabled on the own vport, allowing for proper processing of tagged traffic.

Code statements:
```c
-	MLX5_SET(modify_esw_vport_context_in, in, other_vport, 1);
-	MLX5_SET(modify_esw_vport_context_in, in, other_vport, 1);
-	err = mlx5_eswitch_query_esw_vport_context(esw, esw->manager_vport,
-	return mlx5_eswitch_modify_esw_vport_context(esw, esw->manager_vport,
```
